brief: A seven-cell honeycomb standing on at least three stud spikes facing down as feet.

requirements.evidence: Seven full bases at level 0: piece:0,0,0;full plus its six neighbours (-1,0), (-1,1), (0,-1), (0,1), (1,-1), (1,0) — one centre cell ringed by six, forming a honeycomb. check_build shows all seven in one group.

Three stud-variant spikes placed with facing down at three junctions spread around the cluster: spike:0#-1,0|-1,1|0,0 (west), spike:0#0,-1|0,0|1,-1 (north-east), spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 (south-east), forming a tripod so the cluster stands on them as feet.
requirements.requirement: Standing on at least three stud spikes facing down as feet

requirements.evidence: capOpenFaces added 18 solid end caps and lockJoints added 12 joint bolts; check_build ok with meshClash clear and no issues.
requirements.requirement: House rules: cap open faces and lock joints once parts are settled

finish.summary: A seven-cell honeycomb: one full base at 0,0,0 ringed by its six full neighbours at level 0, standing on three stud spikes placed facing down at three spread junctions (west, north-east, south-east) as a tripod of feet. Open faces capped with 18 solid caps and joints locked with 12 bolts; check_build passes with meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 brass heat-set insert, 7.6 mm (initeq M6-1.0 Short)
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Seven-cell honeycomb on stud-spike feet — first checking the bench and where pieces and downward spikes fit.

result.note: A spike stands where three bases meet at a corner: place three bases around one junction first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
